issues.title: expect(bench.call(...)).rejects hangs until the call times out
issues.doing: Testing on the bench that a device call fails with a code: links, that the store turns a unique-constraint failure into LINK_TAKEN with await expect(store.call("links","add",...)).rejects.toMatchObject({code:"LINK_TAKEN"}); files, that the store refuses a too-large upload with await expect(store.call(...)).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "TOO_LARGE" }).
issues.happened: links: the test timed out; the received error was 'RackError: store.links.add timed out after 30000 ms', though the stub had thrown at once. store.call(...).catch((e)=>e) returned LINK_TAKEN in 1 ms. files: the test timed out (5 s, then 30 s when raised) and bun test took 60 s to end. The same call caught with .catch(e => e) returns the RackError in 3 ms. The same rejects.toMatchObject on a BAD_NAME error passed.
issues.expected: .rejects to see the rejection with its code as for any promise, or the testing guide to say how to assert that a call fails with a code
issues.where: docs/guides/testing.md#members-of-a-bench, call(...): does not say what call returns or how to assert on a rejection (a Bun quirk or a property of RackError may be involved; the cause was not found)
issues.workaround: .catch((e) => e) then expect(failure.code).toBe(...); source not read, cause not found
